name: Captura – AI Chatbot for Lead Generation & Call Booking
author: Kings Crest Global

sections.description:
Captura is an AI-powered chatbot plugin that integrates Google’s Gemini AI to provide intelligent, automated customer support on your WordPress website. The chatbot can answer visitor questions, generate leads, and provide 24/7 customer assistance.

Get Pro Version: https://kingscrestglobal.com/contact/

Key Features

  • AI-powered responses using Google Gemini
  • Custom knowledge base from your WordPress content
  • Real-time chat interface
  • Conversation history and analytics
  • Customizable chatbot appearance
  • Lead capture and contact management

External Services

This plugin uses the Google Gemini API to provide AI-powered chatbot functionality and content indexing features.

Google Gemini API

What it does:
The plugin connects to Google’s Gemini API to:
– Generate chatbot responses to user questions
– Create vector embeddings for content indexing
– Process and understand natural language queries

When data is sent:
– When a website visitor sends a message through the chatbot
– When site administrators index content (posts/pages) into the knowledge base
– When the chatbot searches for relevant content to answer questions

What data is sent:
– User messages/questions submitted through the chatbot
– Website content (post titles, excerpts, and content) when indexing is performed
– API key for authentication
– No personally identifiable information (PII) is sent without user consent

Service Provider:
Google LLC

API Endpoint:
https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/

Terms of Service:
https://policies.google.com/terms

Privacy Policy:
https://policies.google.com/privacy

Gemini API Terms of Service:
https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms

Note: Users must provide their own Google Gemini API key. By using this plugin, you agree to Google’s terms of service and privacy policy. The plugin does not store or transmit user data except as necessary to communicate with the Gemini API.

Privacy & Data

This plugin connects to Google’s Gemini API. Please review:
– Our plugin does not collect user data beyond what’s necessary for chatbot functionality
– All data sent to Gemini API is governed by Google’s privacy policy
– Users should review Google’s terms before using this plugin
– Site administrators are responsible for informing their visitors about AI chatbot usage

For GDPR compliance, we recommend:
– Adding information about the chatbot to your privacy policy
– Informing users that their messages are processed by Google’s AI
– Obtaining user consent where required by law
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/captura-chatbot/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Captura settings and enter your Google Gemini API key
  4. Configure your chatbot settings
  5. Index your content for the knowledge base
  6. The chatbot widget will appear on your website

Getting a Gemini API Key

  1. Visit https://ai.google.dev/
  2. Sign in with your Google account
  3. Navigate to “Get API Key”
  4. Create a new API key
  5. Copy the API key and paste it in the plugin settings
sections.faq:
Do I need a Google Gemini API key?

Yes, you must have your own Google Gemini API key. You can get one for free at https://ai.google.dev/

Is the API key free?

Google offers a free tier for the Gemini API with usage limits. Check Google’s pricing page for current details.

What data is sent to Google?

The plugin sends user questions and your indexed content to Google’s Gemini API for processing. See the “External Services” section for full details.

Is my data secure?

All communications with the Gemini API are encrypted via HTTPS. We recommend reviewing Google’s privacy policy for their data handling practices.

Can I customize the chatbot appearance?

Yes, the plugin includes customization options for colors, text, and positioning.
